purpose: Test causal full-hover gyro calibration and its interaction with the existing learned rotation residual
hypothesis: Persistent gyro offset contributes to orientation drift; using the complete documented initial hover avoids part of the startup transient contamination
training_budget: No retraining, architecture changes or parameter search

calibration.window_basis: 200-step initial hover at 200 Hz in pinned generator; selected from source/startup audit before candidate evaluation
calibration.anchor: first IMU timestamp minus first positive sample interval observed in the first frame; reject calibration if fewer than two unique initial samples
calibration.sample_selection: initial anchor < timestamp <= anchor + 1.0 seconds, with existing 1e-6 boundary tolerance; unique timestamps only
calibration.estimate: sample mean gyro in IMU coordinates, computed by bounded online moments
calibration.activation: finish after emitting the first frame at or beyond the window end; correct only subsequent whole frame intervals
calibration.rejection: freeze rejection on bad initial anchor, insufficient coverage, or failed low-variation/prior checks; never retry or extend window
calibration.known_limitation: low-variation gates cannot distinguish small constant true rotation from sensor bias; this method assumes a documented initial hover

invariants: Identical raw paired images, raw IMU-derived network state and ONNX predictions in all four cells
Identical camera-local translation increments; world positions may differ through orientation composition
Bias subtraction in IMU coordinates before every sample exponential, followed by camera extrinsic rotation
No pose reset, gravity realignment, output hold, retrospective correction, map correction or ground truth input
Existing default metadata keeps calibration disabled

validation.splits: all four original simulated validation flights from scenes 5/6; no public episodes
validation.selection: among eligible candidates, lowest equal-episode mean Sim3 ATE; then rotation RMSE; then protocol order; otherwise retain current
validation.scope: Engineering acceptance thresholds, not a statistical significance claim
validation.repeat: repeat all four complete validation rollouts; require identical outputs, predictions and calibration state

public_comparison.variants: unchanged official baseline plus all four factorial cells, then full selected-model repeat
public_comparison.timing: serial after validation and other compute stop
public_comparison.replication: exact pose/twist and per-episode accuracy reproduction; report fuel and wall time separately

stop_rule: One fixed calibration experiment; no public-driven tuning. Together with failed v3, a second non-improving round ends this continuation with a saved decision point.
